title: Second-hand goes mainstream
passage: Buying second-hand was once seen as a sign of hard times. These days, however, it has become a respectable habit. Apps make it easy to browse used clothes and furniture, and younger shoppers often prefer them to new goods. The appeal is not only affordable prices: buying used also reduces waste. What began as a way to save money has turned into a small movement against throwaway culture. For many, a used item carries a story that a new one cannot.

vocab.example: Teaching is still a respectable profession.
She spent the afternoon browsing second-hand shops.
We should reduce our use of plastic.

options.text: 二手商品的质量越来越差
买二手从省钱变成一种环保生活方式

quiz.explanation: 首句说二手曾是「艰难时世」的标志，These days, however 转折后说它成了体面习惯，末句落到「反对一次性消费文化的小型运动」，所以是「从省钱变成环保生活方式」。

quiz.stem: 文中 respectable 在这里最接近哪个意思？
quiz.explanation: respectable 指「体面的、社会认可的」；文中说买二手从「艰难时世的标志」变成 respectable habit，强调它不再丢面子。

quiz.stem: “younger shoppers often prefer them to new goods” 中的 them 指什么？
quiz.explanation: them 回指前半句的 used clothes and furniture——年轻买家更喜欢这些二手衣物和家具，而不是新商品。

quiz.stem: 第一句与第二句之间的逻辑关系是？
quiz.explanation: These days, however 是转折信号：过去被视为艰难时世的标志，如今却成了体面习惯。

translation.instructions: 把下面的句子译成中文，先自己译，再展开参考。

items.source: What began as a way to save money has turned into a small movement against throwaway culture.
items.reference: 最初只是为了省钱，如今却演变成一场反对一次性消费文化的小型运动。
points: What began as ... has turned into ... 的主语从句
throwaway culture 译出「一次性消费文化」

items.source: The appeal is not only affordable prices: buying used also reduces waste.
items.reference: 它的吸引力不仅在于价格实惠：购买二手还能减少浪费。
points: affordable 译出「价格实惠/负担得起」
reduces waste 译出「减少浪费」

output.instructions: 用本轮没把握的词造句，或描述一个相似场景；先自己写，再看参考。

tasks.prompt: 用 respectable 写一句话：描述一种变得体面的习惯或职业。
tasks.reference: Repairing old furniture has become a respectable way to earn a living.

tasks.prompt: 用 affordable 写一句话：描述一种负担得起的东西。
tasks.reference: The city needs more affordable housing for young families.
